key.itemblocker.openconfig: Ouvrir la configuration du bloqueur d'items
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.itemblock:
Allows you to block certain items from being picked up.

Now with compatibility with Pickup Notifications and Pickup Notifier!
itemblocker.text.no_items: Aucun item bloqué pour le moment !
itemblocker.text.items_handled: Choose how blocked items are handled:
itemblocker.text.works_on_server: - Works on any server without server-side installation
itemblocker.text.automatically: - Automatically drops picked up blocked items
itemblocker.text.briefly_show: - May briefly show items in inventory before dropping
itemblocker.text.no_pickup: - Prevents items from being picked up at all
itemblocker.text.server_installation: - REQUIRES mod to be installed on the server
itemblocker.text.wont_work: - Will not work on servers without the mod
itemblocker.text.restart_note: Note: Restart may be required for changes to take effect
itemblocker.text.enter_name: Entrez un nom pour votre préréglage :
itemblocker.text.after_creation: After creating, you can add items to this preset.
itemblocker.text.no_preset_items: Aucun item dans ce préréglage pour le moment
itemblocker.text.invalid: Invalid preset code! Make sure you copied it correctly.
itemblocker.text.paste_code_shared: Paste a preset code shared by another player:
itemblocker.text.preset_contains: The preset code contains the name and all items.
itemblocker.text.no_presets: Aucun préréglage pour le moment. Créez-en un !
itemblocker.text.press_copy_key: Appuyez sur Ctrl+C pour copier le code ci-dessous:
itemblocker.text.share_code: Partagez ce code avec d'autres joueurs !
itemblocker.text.other_player_info: They can paste it using 'Import Preset'.
itemblocker.text.item_show_ids: - Items are shown using their item ids instead of their names
itemblocker.text.item_show_names: - Items are shown using their item names instead of their IDs
itemblocker.text.looks_like_name: - Will look like this: Grass Block
itemblocker.text.enter_new_name: Enter a new name for your preset
itemblocker.text.already_exists: A preset with that name already exists
itemblocker.text.rename_to_existing: Cannot rename the preset to it's existing name
itemblocker.text.confirm_delete: Are you sure you want to delete: %1$s?
itemblocker.text.permanently_remove: This will permanently remove the preset and its contents!
itemblocker.text.shift_click: You can hold Shift + Click to skip this popup.
itemblocker.text.temporary_disabled: Filter is temporarily disabled while§e %1%s §ris held
itemblocker.text.invald_id: Invalid Item ID, did you type it correctly?
itemblocker.tutorial.skip: Click or press any button to skip.
itemblocker.tutorial.item_ids: This is where you enter your enter item id's. For example minecraft:grass_block. Modded items should work here too!
itemblocker.tutorial.submit_item: Press this button to submit an item after entering it in the text box. You can also press Enter or Confirmation to add items.
itemblocker.tutorial.clear_all: This is the Clear all button, you can use this to clear all the items in your list.
itemblocker.tutorial.options: This is the options button. It opens the options screen and allows you to change different settings.
itemblocker.tutorial.presets: This is the presets button. It opens the presets screen and allows you to create, edit and share presets with others. Presets allow you to quickly apply a list of items you want to block.
itemblocker.tutorial.blocked_items: This is where your blocked items are shown, if your blocked item list ever gets full, you can scroll down or use the scrollbar to view more items.
itemblocker.tutorial.tutorial: You can use this button to revisit this tutorial at any time.
